note: Baseline from the P1-03 remediation pass (2026-08-02): Go/PHP/.NET SDK base images bumped to their latest published builds, Go additionally to a currently-supported minor (was 1.22, EOL), apt-get upgrade added to every Dockerfile, and an unused ImageMagick suite removed from the Rust image - a combined 45% reduction (2508 -> 1367 CRITICAL/HIGH) verified by live Trivy scans, not estimated. What remains here is the baseline: mostly Linux kernel-header CVEs (linux-libc-dev - kernel code that never executes inside a container, and a mandatory transitive dependency of libc6-dev/build-essential, confirmed not removable without breaking cgo/native-extension compilation) and Debian perl-tooling CVEs (perl/perl-base/perl-modules/libperl5.x - a mandatory transitive dependency of adduser/debconf, confirmed not removable). CI fails on any CRITICAL/HIGH finding NOT in this list (a genuinely new vulnerability) or once expires_at passes (forces periodic re-triage instead of silent indefinite acceptance) - see docker/check_vuln_baseline.py.
